label: caiso138 control
definition: (CONTROL — not a keeper candidate.) The byte-identical keeper-recipe control arm of the caiso-138 A/B: the caiso-130 nameplate-aware keeper recipe replayed with caiso_firm_import_envelope_clip left off (no delta). Verified byte-identical to the committed caiso-130 keeper on prices and dumps, all three years; establishes the pre-clip baseline (1.086/1.716/0.965 TWh/yr WECC_PNW alpha-dump) against which caiso-138 envelope-clip is measured.
